primary_title: A single autophosphorylation site on KDR/Flk-1 is essential for VEGF-A-dependent activation of PLC-gamma and DNA synthesis in vascular endothelial cells
decision_basis: Primary KDR Y1175F perturbation reduces VEGF-A-induced MAP kinase phosphorylation in endothelial cells, supporting an explicit site-specific ERK1/2 pathway/readout edge; this is not direct pY1175-MAPK binding.
limitations_preserved: Preserve Y1175 site specificity, VEGF-A/endothelial model, ERK1/2 readout semantics, and no SCI or terminal-TF inference.
